stay_id._comment_: unique identifier for the hospital stay

sex._comment_: administrative sex of the newborn (e.g. {0: F, 1: M})

birth_date._comment_: date of birth of the newborn

adm_date._comment_: exact date and time of admission to the hospital

age_at_admission_days._comment_: rounded age in days at the time of admission

length_stay._comment_: total length of stay in the neonatology department (NAT)

length_stay_hours._comment_: total length of stay in hours in the neonatology department (NAT)

ga_days._comment_: rounded gestational age at birth in days

ga_weeks._comment_: rounded gestational age at birth in weeks

death._comment_: flag indicating if the newborn died during hospitalization

death_hospital._comment_: flag indicating if death occurred in the hospital

death_nat._comment_: flag indicating if death occurred in the neonatology department

death_date._comment_: date and time of death, if applicable

sepsis._comment_: flag indicating whether the newborn developed sepsis

sepsis_halos._comment_: flag for Hospital-Acquired Late On-Set (HALOS) sepsis

infection._comment_: flag for other infections not classified as sepsis

neg_outcomes._comment_: flag for presence of any negative outcome (composite variable)

datetime_hemoculture._comment_: date and time of first positive hemoculture for sepsis

datetime_hemoculture_sepsis_not_confirme._comment_: date and time of hemoculture taken but sepsis not confirmed

time_hours_sepsis._comment_: time from admission to sepsis onset in hours

pma_at_admission_days._comment_: rounded postmenstrual age at admission in days

pma_at_admission_weeks._comment_: rounded postmenstrual age at admission in weeks

time_to_cut_5d_abx._comment_: time from admission to end of 5-day antibiotic window

time_hours_abx._comment_: time of antibiotic administration from admission (in hours)

control_trajectories._comment_: flag for control (non-septic) cases in trajectory analysis

incl_criteria_trajectories._comment_: flag indicating whether patient meets inclusion criteria for trajectory analysis

incl_criteria_prediction._comment_: flag indicating whether patient is included in predictive trajectory modeling

start_record._comment_: timestamp marking the start of usable time series data for antibiotics

HR._comment_: heart rate in beats per minute

RR._comment_: respiratory rate in breaths per minute
